_about: FootGround.cs: per-foot ground raycast + two-bone leg IK + pelvis offset (lowest foot defines the hips) + foot levelling + toe flattening, in LateUpdate after the Animator. ankleHeight = Foot bone height above the sole when flat (m); plantSnap/maxLift = ankle height above its ground within which the foot is fully planted / released (m); pelvisDownMax/UpMax = hips travel limits (m); pelvisSmooth = seconds; ignoreLayers = physics layers the rays skip (8 characters, 9 other fighters); states[] = per Animator state weight 0..1 (roll tucks, so weighted down); unlisted states use the global weight. enabled=false switches it off.
